package.name: camera_compress_transport
package.description: image_transport plugins that publish camera_compress, vaapi_compress, depth_rvl_compress, and depth_png_compress topics. Color is JPEG. 16-bit depth is lossless RVL on depth_rvl_compress, or PNG level 1 with RLE on depth_png_compress. vaapi_compress uses VA-API for color JPEG.
